SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: If off, use the pull-up menu's JavaScript button to allow it for one tab. Long press that button to manage sites that always get JavaScript.

ListPreference.android:summary: %s. If off or Wi-Fi only, the pull-up menu's image button loads them for one tab; long press it for sites that always get images.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Zoom re-flows text
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Wrap text to the screen after zooming. Can be annoying; you can bind re-flow to a gesture instead.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Wide viewport
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Let pages lay out wider than the screen instead of squeezing everything in.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Open pages zoomed out
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Zoom all the way out when a page loads. Double tap to zoom in. Works best with wide viewport.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Text auto-size
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Boost small fonts to make them readable.

SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:title: Dark pages
SwitchPreferenceCompat.android:summary: Ask sites for their dark theme and darken pages that have none.
